steps.note: S5.1.1 says the last two rows restore the scratch values and S5.1.2 states the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of the initial side and central values a,c.
S5.1.3 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero or two, and self coefficient one.
S5.1.4 gives central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S5.2 states forward, inverse, forward invocations sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary value restored, and its quote gives the stages (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x).

The plan never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals and dimensions (the residual table); S5.4.4 only says edges join comparable nondegenerate labels and that the 3-to-4 center edge loses dimension h.
S5.4.3 states only the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (generally, along side wires); it never gives the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 for the 2-to-5 edge.
S5.4.4 makes center 3-to-4 the only decreasing edge losing h, S5.4.2 gives sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and S5.4.5 gives telescoping and absolute Wm-2N+2L.
The plan asserts orthonormal residual bases (S5.5, S5.5.1) and nondegenerate labels but never derives that nonzero residuals are nonalternating (norm-one vectors) or absorbs alternating planes.
S5.4.6 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.
S5.5.1 gives the weight formula, additivity mod four when z.w=0, and q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual.

S5.5.2 gives odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2(-1)^{v.x}, and after conjugating by H^{tensor m} the translation kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse (the H diag(1,-1) H = X identity is implicit in the conjugation).

S5.5.3 counts one kernel per residual basis vector giving s_c, but the plan never treats k columns or the tensor-power factorisation (C_V C_U^{-1})^{tensor k} with one factor per residual vector acting on all columns.

S5.5.4 gives the 27 coordinates with C^{-1} and the identity C=iZC^{-1}Z but only 'sign and phase corrections'; it omits zero-label frame I and full-label C^{tensor m}, Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after, and the negation of X outputs.
S5.4.7.3 states the deficit N-2L_b>0 because L_b<N/2, giving s_b<W_b m (and S5.5.3 states the complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0).
S5.6.1 states eta_b=339/22587335000000, matching the paper.
S5.6.1 states eta_c=73/19906842167500, matching the paper.
S5.6.1 gives both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, S5.6.2 gives log m<20 and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), and S5.6.3 concludes s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.

S5.7 only states the factorisation A=E_1 Pi E_2 (quoting the lemma statement at line 1371); the elimination proof (topmost row, rightmost pivot, clearing by lower-triangular operations, repeating on active indices) is not given.
S5.8 asserts a fixed odd prime q exists but never says it avoids every denominator in a finite table of factors so the identities specialise to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S5.8.1 states a lower triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier coordinates that still hold original values.
S5.8.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange per one of Pi, and S5.8.4 gives a interchanges in all.
The plan defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu=min{j>=1: m^j>=B}, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), and S8.1.1 fixes C_1=20, though it never states nu=11.
S5.11.7.1 gives A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)<=8e at leaves with E bounding the gates and corrections of one network invocation, and S5.11.7.2 explains why s rather than s/W is used.
The plan gives B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and the total below 128mB^2 d^{nu+3}<=C_0 d^{C_1}.

S5.11.7.7 gives values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus <=2^l (addition doubles, halving adds a bit) so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits suffice, and S5.11.7.8 gives epsilon*C_1<1 implies Delta=o(p).
S5.11.8.3 gives absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays and S5.11.8.4 gives truncation error below sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: 19 of 26 present, none wrong. Plan P02 carries the bank-exchange-network sub-steps (B1-B4), rank-saving (R1-R4) and simultaneous-layer (S1-S5) in full. It is partial on label-residual-budget (L3, L5 present; no residual table L1, no h-2 complement L2, no nonalternating/orthonormal-basis derivation L4), complex-phase-interface (P1, P2 present; no k-column tensoring P3, endpoint repair detail P4 reduced to 'sign and phase corrections'), and matrix-shear (M3, M4 present; no elimination proof M1, no prime-avoiding-denominators argument M2).
